maintenance_sequence.eventual_business_outcome: eligible to finish from durable progress

admission.required: Every resident/pending delivery has an explicit start-or-return/recovery disposition; no new handler starts after authoritative drain gate

progress_effects.required: Current epoch protected transaction, not a pre-read or local stop

compatibility.required: No format3 continuation on revision7; retained v2 dependencies for unfinished format2 work or demonstrated compatible migration/recovery

budget.required: Finite remaining deadline with explicit margin and hold/escalation

acceptance_evidence.native_behavior: Host events and child metadata, distinct from plan correctness and evaluator score
acceptance_evidence.candidate: Final allowed files digest and unchanged protected input/native closure hashes
acceptance_evidence.artifact_observation: Command stdout + exit + observer input/code digest; not real-runtime behavior
acceptance_evidence.independent_review: Candidate-specific assignment/findings and correction/review chain; separate from final independent evaluator grading

native_collector_limit: prepare drops unique scenario id/acceptance; parent must bind scenario id and fixture index hash externally. It prepends $tal-worker-rollout on every turn.
status: frozen authored invariants; raw local observation commands completed; no native/model execution
